answer_1.quote: We treat proof generation as a sequence-to-sequence task. Given a formal FOL theorem (x), which includes relevant axioms that describe the features of the concepts mentioned in the theorem, our goal is to generate a formal proof (y) that can be automatically verified by the formal compiler compile(.) .

answer_2.quote: Following Zhao et al. ( ), we select the cumulative pass rate as the metric for evaluation, which is the proportion of theorems solved at least once.

answer_4.quote: To assess the reliability of the manual verification stage, we conducted a human annotation study measuring inter-annotator agreement. Two experts in formal reasoning independently evaluated 40 problems-20 from the manually collected corpus and 20 from TPTP-Revised-for correctness and logical consistency of theorem statements and their Lean 4 formalizations.
answer_4.guideline: correctness and logical consistency of theorem statements and their Lean 4 formalizations
